title: Human Computer Interaction: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
programme: Bachelor of Business Information Technology / information Technology
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Examine the ergonomics aspects that are mainly associated with the use of computer-based information systems.
Discuss common characteristics of graphical user interfaces (GUI) as applied in computer technology.
Discuss the techniques you would apply as a system developer to achieve an effective screen design.
Evaluate psychological factors that may influence human-computer interaction (HCI).

In recognition of organizational obligation to address the special needs of persons with disabilities, explain various ways in which this can be achieved in a typical organization with computer-based systems.
Assess the advantages of considering software learnability in the context of system usability.
Examine the key requirements/rules in enabling effective user interface design.
Assess how well-designed direct manipulation interfaces can promote user experience.
Discuss the main functionalities of usability testing tools.
Discuss the effects of ignoring the computer-human interface in systems development.
Examine the factors that a developer would consider when designing a screen layout for a database application that is characterized by forms for massive data entry.
